title: Grand Tour digital — TEI dataset of early modern travel testimonies (Grand Tour TEI)
notes:
TEI-XML files underlying the digital edition of a corpus of early modern travel testimonies (Reiseselbstzeugnisse). Full text was created with Transkribus HTR plus NER, i.e. project-released corrected machine text, published as an open dataset (CC BY-SA 4.0) on 30 September 2026. The corpus spans the 16th–18th centuries, so only part falls within the catalogue window; the dedicated edition website was not located, so the Zenodo deposit (and the git.hab.de repository it points to) is the stable access point.

Justification: A brand-new (September 2026) Zenodo deposit of corrected HTR/TEI full text of early modern travel accounts produced by a DFG-funded project (2022–2025, project no. 469982284) at the Herzog August Bibliothek. Found via a Zenodo search for recent early modern TEI editions. Not in the catalogue.
Found at: https://zenodo.org/records/23055358
